extension.description: Automatically mutes bad words during video playback using subtitle timing. Works with local files and streaming add-ons such as ororo.tv.
extension.disclaimer: Mute accuracy depends on subtitle timing.
extension.news: 1.6.0: - Subtitles are no longer shown on screen. The filter works with subtitles switched off: local files are read from disk directly (never displayed), and streaming subtitles are only enabled long enough to capture the timing data, then hidden again. - The "Hide subtitles after scanning" setting has been removed — profanity text is always kept off the screen. 1.5.0: - Fix false positives caused by overly greedy wildcards (sh*t no longer matches "shift", c*nt no longer matches "count"). - Ship a curated word list. Innocent/common words (god, hell, abuse, etc.) are no longer muted by default. - Use the active video player for subtitle discovery instead of a hardcoded player id.
